prevWeekResults:
Week 1's schema + foundation work is already moving rankings (≈4 days of data — early and noisy, but directional):

  • "webflow designer jobs": #23 → #9 — jumped onto page 1.
  • 5 new keywords entered tracking: "hire webflow developers" #11, "seo specialist salary in us" #10, "hire webflow designer" #21, "webflow freelancers" #29, "webflow freelance" #32.
  • Small gains: "webflow career" #7→#6, "webflow developer job" #8→#7.
  • Rich-result eligibility showing up: FAQ/featured-snippet + AI-Overview (SGE) features now appear on target SERPs (e.g. "webflow developer job description"), and your JobPosting pages still hold #1 in the AI block for "[city] webflow developer".

Caveat: a few terms dipped on normal early volatility ("webflow developer" #20→#27, "webflow dev" #18→#26). The llms.txt + schema impact on AI citations and rich results typically takes 2–4 weeks to surface in Search Console.
